---
title: Custom kinds
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
crossref:
  custom:
    - kind: float
      key: vid
      reference-prefix: Video
      caption-prefix: Video
      latex-list-of-file-extension: lov
      latex-list-of-description: Videos
    - kind: float
      key: diag
      reference-prefix: Diagram
      caption-prefix: Diagram
      latex-list-of-file-extension: lod
      latex-list-of-description: Diag
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    list-of:
      kinds: [lst, vid, diag]
      titles:
        lst: 'Code \"examples\" #1'
      page-break: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'Videos' && ! pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'Diag'
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - 'Code \\"examples\\" #1'
          - 'Videos'
          - 'page-break: true'
---

## Floats

```{.python #lst-code lst-cap="A listing"}
print("hello")
```
